messages:
tess: Heads-up from support: customer saw unexpected charges after a silent v1 fallback. They asked for an "explain" link on invoice lines.
mike: Oof. We need one canonical id to trace a request through edge->router->compute->billing.
oliver: Agreed. Proposal: emit X-Redwood-Routing-Id on every request, persist it in traces and billing events. Also include served_model and intended_model in the invoice drilldown.
sam.k: SDK change: when served_model != intended_model return a lightweight warning with routing_id and warning code MODEL_MISMATCH so apps can log it.
billing-bot: @finance FYI adding routing_id and billed_rate_tag looks fine but we need a backfill window.
infra-bot: I'll draft an infra RFC and a feature-flagged rollout: phase1 telemetry + routing_id, phase2 SDK+console drilldown, phase3 per-route strict toggle + opt-in header `X-Redwood-Fallback: deny`.
tess: Timeline: phase1 in 2 weeks so CSMs can start reconciling. Owners: infra=oliver, sdk=sam.k, console=tess, billing=mike.
